<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="tinderGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height=" thirty" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="22" y="21" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <line x1="316" y1="18" x2="316" y2="12" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="321" y1="18" x2="321" y2="10" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="326" y1="18" x2="326" y2="8" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="342" cy="14" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <line x1="345" y1="17" x2="349" y2="21" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <rect x="359" y="9" width="22" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="361" y="11" width="16" height="8" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="381" y="13" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <line x1="22" y1="54" x2="368" y2="54" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <rect x="14" y="30" width="76" height="36" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="39,48 34,43 39,38" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="49" y="51" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="medium" fill="#4A4A4A">Back</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="315" y="30" width="61" height="36" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="345" y="51" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="medium" fill="#EA5D6B">Cancel</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Title -->
  <text x="195" y="103" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Add a photo</text>
  <text x="195" y="128" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="book" fill="#939393">Choose how you want to add your first photo</text>

  <!-- Camera option shadow and card -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="153" width="342" height=" ninety" rx="18" fill="#000000" opacity="0.04"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="151" width="342" height="90" rx="18" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    <circle cx="76" cy="196" r="30" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.18"/>
    <rect x="59" y="184" width="34" height="24" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.4"/>
    <rect x="67" y="180" width="12" height="6" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.4"/>
    <circle cx="76" cy="196" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.4"/>
    <text x="124" y="190" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">Take a photo</text>
    <text x="124" y="212" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="book" fill="#FFFFFF">Use your camera now</text>
    <polyline points="337,190 343,196 337,202" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Gallery option shadow and card -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="259" width="342" height="90" rx="18" fill="#000000" opacity="0.04"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="257" width="342" height="90" rx="18" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="76" cy="302" r="30" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <rect x="59" y="289" width="34" height="26" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="84" cy="296" r="3" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
    <polygon points="62,311 71,301 77,307 82,302 91,311" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="124" y="296" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Choose from gallery</text>
    <text x="124" y="318" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="book" fill="#939393">Pick an existing photo</text>
    <polyline points="337,296 343,302 337,308" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Recent section -->
  <text x="24" y="391" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Recent photos</text>
  <text x="366" y="391" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="medium" fill="#EA5D6B">See all</text>
  <line x1="24" y1="404" x2="366" y2="404" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Photo placeholder grid -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="421" width="105" height="105" rx="12" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <circle cx="105" cy="443" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8"/>
    <polygon points="34,514 62,480 78,496 91,486 119,514" fill="#939393"/>
    <text x="76" y="545" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="book" fill="#939393">Today, 10:22 AM</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="142" y="421" width="105" height="105" rx="12" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="222" cy="443" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polygon points="152,514 180,480 196,496 209,486 237,514" fill="#D0CECD"/>
    <text x="194" y="545" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="book" fill="#939393">Yesterday, 6:45 PM</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="260" y="421" width="106" height="105" rx="12" fill="#EAEDF1"/>
    <circle cx="341" cy="443" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8"/>
    <polygon points="270,514 298,480 314,496 327,486 356,514" fill="#7D8490"/>
    <text x="313" y="545" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="book" fill="#939393">May 18, 2025</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Privacy note -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="29" cy="591" r="10" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <line x1="29" y1="586" x2="29" y2="593" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="29" cy="597" r="1" fill="#939393"/>
  </g>
  <text x="47" y="588" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="book" fill="#939393">Your photos are private until you choose</text>
  <text x="47" y="605" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="book" fill="#939393">to add them to your profile.</text>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="700" width="390" height="144" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="700" x2="390" y2="700" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,733 50,724 61,733 61,746 39,746" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="36,734 50,722 64,734" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="50" y="766" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="book" fill="#939393">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="128" cy="733" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="128" y1="726" x2="128" y2="740" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="121" y1="733" x2="135" y2="733" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="128" y="766" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="book" fill="#939393">Discover</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="733" r="23" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    <polyline points="195,720 199,729 205,733 200,734 195,744 191,735 185,733 191,729" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="195" y="766" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="medium" fill="#EA5D6B">Add photo</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="257" y="725" width="22" height="16" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="262,741 260,747 267,742" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="264" cy="733" r="1.5" fill="#939393"/>
    <circle cx="271" cy="733" r="1.5" fill="#939393"/>
    <text x="268" y="766" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="book" fill="#939393">Chats</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="339" cy="728" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="339" cy="744" rx="13" ry="7" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="339" y="766" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="book" fill="#939393">Profile</text>
  </g>
  <rect x="153" y="827" width="84" height="5" rx="3" fill="#000000"/>
</svg>
